title: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
paperTitle: 2022年6月大学英语四级真题（第2套）
prompt: 从前有个人养了一群羊。一天早上他准备出去放羊，发现少了一只。他仔细一看，看到羊栏(sheepfold) 上有个窟窿。显然，夜间有狼钻进羊圈叼走了羊。 邻居劝他修羊栏，可是他不听。 第二天，他发现狼又通过窟窿叼走一只羊。他想起邻居的话，就赶快堵上窟窿,把羊栏补好。此后，他的羊再也没有被狼叼走。 故事告诉我们:出了问题及时补救，可以防止蒙受更大损失。
reference: Long long ago, there was a man who raised a flock of sheep. One morning, when he was about to take the sheep out to graze, he found that one of them was missing. On a closer look, he saw that there was a hole in the sheepfold. Obviously, during the night a wolf had got into the sheepfold and carried off a sheep. His neighbour advised him to mend the sheepfold, but he would not listen. The next day, he found that another sheep had been carried off by the wolf through the hole. Remembering what his neighbour had said, he quickly blocked up the hole and mended the sheepfold. From then on, his sheep were never carried off by wolves again. The story tells us that fixing problems in time can prevent us from suffering greater losses.
